author: Unreal Engine
description: Join us for a deep dive into full-body animation with the new MetaHuman Animator Markerless Motion Capture plugin, which turns ordinary video from a phone or webcam into animation for your MetaHuman characters. Michael Black from Epic’s research team will explain how the technology works as Ben Kidd walks through using it on a real project, from capture to final shot. We’ll be joined by filmmaker Martin Bell who shows what an independent creator can do with it.
title: MetaHuman Animator Markerless Motion Capture Deep Dive | Inside Unreal
